about.title: Sunnyvale Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Three people died in Sunnyvale traffic collisions in 2025, according to public records, alongside 603 others who were injured across 457 crashes. Each of those numbers is a household in Santa Clara County that changed overnight. When a death follows someone else's carelessness — on El Camino Real, along SR-237, or on a quieter stretch of Mathilda or Fair Oaks Avenue — California law gives certain family members a way to seek civil accountability. A wrongful death claim is not the same as a criminal case; it can move forward whether or not charges are ever filed. The people who may bring it are limited, starting with a surviving spouse or domestic partner and children, then certain dependents or heirs. Recoverable losses include funeral and burial expenses, the financial support the person would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship and guidance. LawProactive is not a law firm. We are a free service that connects Sunnyvale families with an independent attorney who handles these claims on contingency, so nothing is owed unless there is a recovery.

whyChoose.title: Why Sunnyvale Families Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Clarity on who can file
items.desc: California limits wrongful death standing to a spouse or domestic partner and children first, then certain dependents and heirs. The attorney we connect you with can sort out where your family fits before anything is filed.

items.title: Deadlines handled early
items.desc: Most claims must be filed within two years of the date of death, and the window is shorter when a city, county, or state agency is involved. Getting connected quickly keeps those dates from becoming a problem.

items.title: No fee unless there is a recovery
items.desc: Our connection service is free, and attorneys in the network work on contingency. Your family's finances are already under strain; the legal side should not add to it.

items.question: My family member was killed in a crash on El Camino Real or SR-237. Does it matter that these are state highways?
items.answer: It can. If a claim involves a public entity such as Caltrans, the City of Sunnyvale, or Santa Clara County, California requires a government claim to be filed well before the usual two-year deadline, often within months. An attorney can review the collision report and determine whether any government entity is a potential party, so the shorter timeline is not missed.

items.question: The other driver is facing criminal charges. Do we have to wait for that case to end?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a civil action that runs separately from any criminal prosecution. It does not depend on a conviction, and the two-year clock keeps moving regardless of what happens in criminal court. Many families pursue both at the same time.

items.question: What losses can a wrongful death claim actually cover in California?
items.answer: California allows recovery for funeral and burial costs, the financial support the person would have contributed to the family, and the loss of their love, companionship, and guidance. The specific amount depends entirely on the facts of your situation, and no honest attorney will promise a figure up front. The attorney you are connected with can walk through how each category applies to your family.
